title: Hash Tables: Fast Lookup by Key
subtitle: Mini example guide built from one lecture's notes
intro: The big picture. A hash table answers “is this key here, and what goes with it?” in roughly constant time, no matter how many items you store. Topic 1 shows the trick (turn a key into an array index). Topic 2 shows what happens when two keys want the same slot, and how to keep the table fast as it fills.
